attchmntText: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
sm_name: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Limited
voiceSummary: Shree Tirupati Balaji Agro Trading Company Limited filed an intimation with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the publication of a newspaper advertisement. The advertisement was published on 14th November, 2026 in Business Standard English and Hindi editions. It concerns the un-audited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the 2nd quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. The filing was signed by Rishika Singhai, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The document also contains unrelated auction notices from Ujjivan Small Finance Bank regarding property sales.

attchmntText: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Limited
voiceSummary: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on 13th November 2026. The Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors was taken on record. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 21,170.10 Lakhs. Profit before tax was 1,947.69 Lakhs. Net profit for the period was 1,198.39 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.57. The company is a manufacturer of HDPE woven sacks and jumbo bags. The meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 07:50 P.M.
